content.string: The meeting is called to order at 4:01 PM; it being noted that the following were in remote attendance:  Mayor E. Holder and Councillors M. van Holst, M. Salih, J. Helmer, J. Morgan, A. Hopkins, P. Van Meerbergen, S. Turner, S. Hillier.
